row.evidence: SurveyMonkey's help centre says SCIM (a beta feature) is only for Enterprise teams that have SSO set up, and the pricing page lists SSO under the Enterprise plan (Get a demo, 5+ users).
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM is Enterprise-only (Contact Sales) and needs SSO; Team Advantage $30 and Team Premier $92 per user/mo billed annually, 3-user minimum. SCIM is labelled beta and limited to one IdP per Enterprise team; Users only (no Groups endpoint); deactivated users keep their seat until an admin deletes them; roles, seats and deletion stay manual in SurveyMonkey. Okta's OIN app is SAML/SWA only and JumpCloud's is SAML only; Microsoft's Entra gallery app provisions. Deployed private API apps need Enterprise (drafts on any plan for 90 days). The June Vendr deal-size figure was dropped (no first-party source).

plans.name: Team Advantage
plans.notes: user_api false = no deployed private app (Enterprise required); 90-day draft apps on any plan.

auth.token_source: Settings > User provisioning with SCIM > Generate token (Primary Admin only)
auth.notes: Entra describes it as a long-lived bearer token; it can be revoked in Settings.

endpoints.notes: The SCIM API reference documents Users, Schemas, ResourceTypes and ServiceProviderConfig only; no Groups section.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated account stays on the team and keeps its seat until an admin deletes it; account reassignment and deletion are done in SurveyMonkey.

pagination.notes: ListResponse uses startIndex/itemsPerPage; ServiceProviderConfig filter.maxResults is 1000.

attributes.notes: division maps to SurveyMonkey Divisions; only work emails are stored.

roles.how: Role and seat assignments stay manual in SurveyMonkey.

limitations.text: SCIM is a beta feature for Enterprise teams with SSO set up.
Only one IdP per Enterprise team; Primary Admin must check fit with the CSM first.
Deactivated users still take a seat until an admin deletes them; only deactivated members can be deleted.
SCIM does not deactivate users removed from the IdP before SCIM was enabled.
Roles, seats, account reassignment and deletion are managed in SurveyMonkey, not via SCIM.
Calling the SCIM API without one of SurveyMonkey's IdP integrations is not recommended.

capabilities.notes: Team members are listed via GET /groups/{id}/members; PATCH only updates a member's email. Workgroup membership (sub-teams) can be added/removed. No REST endpoint to add or remove team seats was seen; create_user false = no such endpoint in the REST reference (SCIM only).

endpoints.purpose: Current user's account details including plan
Get a member's details including role and status
Remove a member from a workgroup

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types cover responses, collectors, surveys and app install/uninstall only.

audit_log_api.notes: GET /groups/{group_id}/activities returns team activity data for admins; plan not stated.

rate_limits.text: Draft and private apps: 120 calls/minute and from 500 calls/day; public App Directory apps up to 500,000 requests/day.

limitations.text: Deploying a private app requires Enterprise; draft apps on other plans are disabled after 90 days.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SAML and SWA as checked; SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate are unchecked.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector pages block bots; SurveyMonkey docs do not mention OneLogin.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud article covers SAML SSO only; no SCIM section.

fallbacks.notes: Anyone allowed by the IdP can create or convert an account on first SSO sign-in (shown as invited users).
